name: search
title: Search Tool
description:
Discover what you can do in this admin panel. Without arguments: every page you may open, plus the
executables (actions/forms) and tables of pages that take no params. With `page` (+ `params` for a
page whose path has params, e.g. a record id, as strings): that page's executables and tables. Each
executable lists its `needs` (form/row/selection) and form fields with Laravel validation rules;
a `translatable` field takes an object keyed by locale (see its nestedRules). A form's `values` are
its current data — build edits from them, not from query() rows, which are formatted for display.
A field you omit is absent from the handler's input; resend `values` for fields you keep.
A container's row fields follow it as `name.*.child`; send rows as a list of objects.
Fields listed in a form's `excludedFields` cannot be changed: omit them, or send the value `values`
holds (a repeater row resent whole, at its stored position); execute() refuses any other value.
A richtext value is a Lexical editor state {root: {type: "root", children: [...]}} built from the
node types in its `nodes`; copy the node shape from `values`, the error names a missing key. An
`embeds` entry is a root child {type: "embed", version: 1, id (unique), kind, data} whose
`data` fills that kind's `fields`.
A field with `options: "dynamic"` lists its choices through query() (`executable` + `field`, with
`deps` for the names in its `dependsOn`). A `mask` formats a text value: 9 digit, a letter, * letter
or digit, any other character literal; send the value as the mask formats it, literals included.

page.description: Page slug from a previous search().

params.description: Route params of the page as strings, e.g. {"post": "12"}.

name: query
title: Query Tool
description:
Read rows of a table found by search(). A row is what the admin table receives: its key
(`id` for Eloquent models) and its visible columns, formatted; no other record attributes.
Pass a row unchanged as `row` to execute() for a row action, or keys as `selection`. Filters take
the value shape search() states per filter; search, columnSearch, filters, tabs, sort and perPage
accept only what search() listed for that table, and anything else is refused.
For a field or filter whose options are "dynamic", the same tool lists its choices: pass
`executable` + `field` (a form field) or `table` + `filter`, with an optional `search` text and
`deps` ({parent: value} for every name in the field's dependsOn). Returns {options: [{value,
label}]}, capped like the UI's type-ahead: narrow with search.

table.description: Table name from search(): its rows, or with filter its options.

executable.description: Executable id whose form holds field, for an options lookup.

field.description: Field name as search() lists it, for an options lookup.

filter.description: Filter name of table, for an options lookup.

deps.description: Parent values for a field's dependsOn: {parent: value}.

params.description: Route params of the page, values as strings.

perPage.description: One of the table's pagination options.

search.description: Table-wide search, or the option search of a lookup.

filters.description: Filter values keyed by filter name.

name: execute
title: Execute Tool
description:
Run an executable found by search(), with the user's own permissions. Pass `params` — the route
params of the page the executable lives on, for every executable of that page — and what it `needs`: `form` (field values), `row` (a row from query(),
unchanged: it must keep its `id`) or `selection` (row keys). A call missing what it needs is
refused. Invalid input returns validation errors and runs nothing;
every error is JSON {message, errors?}. Returns the effects the UI would show; a redirect (form
`redirect`, or a `redirect` effect) carries the `page`/`params` it opens so you can search() it next.

params.description: Route params of the page, values as strings.

form.description: Field values, for a form or an action that needs form.

row.description: A row returned by query(), for a row action.

selection.description: Row keys as strings, for a bulk action; integer keys are passed on as integers.
